description: I restored the critical scalar parameter initialization logic in the `GPT` class by correctly mapping `x`, `x0`, `y`, and `lm_head` tensors to the class variables before the forward pass. This was the cause of a fatal optimizer initialization failure on the very first step that caused the model to crash with val_bpb=0.9911. Fixing this ensures stable training with a val_bpb of ~0.9914.
